name: Innovative Circuits Inc
old_description: Product development and engineering support services, including printed circuit board layout and design for smt and thru hole printed circuit board applications
about:
Innovative Circuits Inc operates from Corinth, Mississippi, providing contract electronics manufacturing services. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm’s service portfolio includes product development and engineering support, printed circuit board layout and design for both surface-mount and through-hole applications, circuit board assembly, in-circuit and functional testing, reverse engineering of obsolete or discontinued products, prototype product design and PCB assembly, and finished product assembly and packaging. It handles production runs from prototype through small, medium, and high volumes, aiming to serve as a single-source electronics assembly partner.

The company serves customers in telecommunications, automotive aftermarket, and aviation industries. It is a member of IPC (Association Connecting Electronics Industries).

Innovative Circuits highlights its X-ray and optical vision inspection capabilities as part of its quality assurance, and positions itself as a partner from prototype to full production.
